name: 20720 · Bowie, MD
findings: ZIP 20720 (Bowie) has 180 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 49 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20720 (Bowie) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20720 (Bowie) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 49 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
